QuestInfo.name: Shah Mar, the Prime Minister
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta learned that the great #p2420000# cared for the governing of #m322000000# in place of the royalty for some time. #p2420018# seemed very insistent that the Shah was much older than he looked. Why is that?
QuestInfo.1: #p2420018# told the duo that though #p2420000# is a nice person, he didn't act like a normal human. Alpha and Beta would find out soon enough, when they visited #b#p2420000##k in #b#m322000102##k to get their contest rewards.
QuestInfo.2: The meeting with #p2420000# was a little strange. He spoke of waiting for a master. But who could it be?

0.0: But, I'm just an old man, spouting off. I just think that handsome fella deserves a little recognition for all he's done.
0.1: I think about the #bShah#k a lot nowadays. He and I were close, back when we were young, but as we got older, we grew apart. That pretty little elf face of his stayed the same, and I got wrinkly!
0.2: He works hard for Ariant, even after he outlived almost everybody he's ever known. He must be very lonely. It's a shame he doesn't have a family... Some lady would be right lucky to get a guy like him.

yes.0: Ah, but that's just an old man reminiscing... Let me stamp your hand, and then you can go get your contest winnings from the #bShah#k himself.

npc.0: You just show that stamp to the #bShah#k, and try not to get hypnotized by his gaze.
